name: Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (formerly CAP)

recommended_certs.rationale: 監査の CISA から、ガバナンス・リスク・コンプライアンス特化の CGRC への横展開。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded NIST RMF focus and accreditation support professional governance decisions despite a two-year profile; rebranding and framework overlap limit distinct hiring value without establishing expert scope.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accreditation, recorded DoD recognition and focused NIST RMF coverage support professional governance and authorization work. The two-year profile and knowledge-based exam do not establish broader expert management or hands-on control implementation.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded NIST RMF focus provides useful governance-domain knowledge at a two-year level. Accreditation and DoD listing do not establish professional delivery without stronger applied or experience evidence in this record.
